column1: # The tombstone: the peers, the acknowledgements, the removal (the contract common/contracts/tombstone.md; C06-BLOB-GC-33-01 / IF-OBJECT-TOMBSTONE63-PEERS-01).
# A row: case<TAB>op<TAB>input<TAB>expect<TAB>note. Form — README of the package.

column5: note
all the servers of the door listing, except its own
a decommissioned one (the row platform/decommission/srv-c in the listing) — not in peers
a server's decommission row without a door row — does not change peers
there is no own door row — all the servers of the listing
a silent one, but not decommissioned — in peers: the tombstone waits for its acknowledgement
there are no other servers — peers is empty
the door listing is not confirmed — there is no deletion, the tombstone is not written
the decommission listing is not confirmed — there is no deletion
404 on GET of the copy — an acknowledgement; the copy exists (200) — no
another answer or no answer — an unknown outcome, not an acknowledgement
a peer decommissioned after the tombstone was written — one that acknowledged without GET of the copy (the Architect's answer of 2026-10-25 (2)); a silent non-decommissioned one — no
the decommission listing is not confirmed — the decommission is not an acknowledgement; a peer's 404 — an acknowledgement as usual
one that acknowledged stays in acked and is not asked again; a new 404 is appended
all peers acknowledged and exactly 7 days (604800 s) have passed — remove
all acknowledged, but 7 days have not passed — keep
not all peers acknowledged — keep, however much has passed
peers is empty — there is nobody to acknowledge, remove after 7 days
the key is written at the deleter again after written — remove without acknowledgements
a write again before 7 days — remove at once: without acknowledgements and without the term (the Architect's answer of 2026-10-25 (1))
an unreadable tombstone — an unknown outcome: do not remove
the key is written again over an unreadable tombstone — the write after written is not proven: do not remove (C05-WRITTEN-AFTER-GONE-02)
